title: The Automatic door at the station
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：automatic　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 automatic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the observer wrote of ① an automatic door at the station in the log, and everybody in the observatory said at once that it was ② more automatic than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the observer, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the automatic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most automatic door at the station anybody in the observatory had ever seen, or so the log for November 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too automatic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the automatic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an automatic reply, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as automatic as the reply they had once had in the old observatory. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was automatic or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something automatic, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next observatory called the whole plan ⑧ quite automatic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the automatic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, year after year, she wrote of another automatic door at the station in the same log, and the work, which took two nights, seemed  more automatic than anybody had expected.  The most automatic reply in the whole observatory, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the automatic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 自动（前置定语 an automatic door at the station：1983 年观测员在观测记录里记下的那件自动的门）
B. adj. 自动／不假思索（比较级 more automatic than：文中两处，一处比车站的门，一处比预想）
C. adj. 自动／不假思索（最高级 the most automatic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 自动（表语 too automatic to do：母亲觉得它太自动，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 不假思索（前置定语 an automatic reply：叔叔把整件事称作一桩不假思索的回答）
F. adj. 不假思索（同级比较 as automatic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩回答相比）
G. adj. 不假思索（后置定语 something automatic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 不假思索（受程度副词修饰 quite automatic：那位助手的评价）

items.q: an automatic door at the station
the most automatic door at the station anybody

answers.why: automatic 意为“自动”，1983 年观测员在观测记录里记下的是“一件自动的门”，此处作前置定语 an automatic door at the station。
automatic 意为“自动”，此处用比较级 more automatic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
automatic 意为“自动”，观测记录上 十一月 那行字说它是观测站里最自动的一件，故用最高级 the most automatic door at the station。
automatic 意为“自动”，母亲认为这件东西“太自动了，谁也用不上”，too automatic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
automatic 意为“不假思索”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩不假思索的回答”，此处作前置定语 an automatic reply。
automatic 意为“不假思索”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩回答一样不假思索”，同级比较用 as automatic as。
automatic 意为“不假思索”，观测记录上那半行字要的是“不假思索的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something automatic。
automatic 意为“不假思索”，邻观测站来的那位助手认为这套计划“相当不假思索”，quite 修饰原级 automatic。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，观测员在观测记录里记下了一件自动的门。（an automatic door at the station）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更自动。（more automatic than …）
母亲觉得它太自动，谁也用不上。（too automatic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩不假思索的回答。（an automatic reply）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩回答一样不假思索。（as automatic as …）
到了 1990 年，观测记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件不假思索的东西。（something automatic）
answers: In 1983 the observer wrote of an automatic door at the station in the log.
Everybody said it was more automatic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too automatic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an automatic reply.
He said nobody would call it as automatic as the reply they had once had.
By 1990 the log asked for nothing but something automatic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 automatic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the observer wrote of an automatic door at the station in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most automatic door at the station in the observatory, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too automatic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an automatic reply, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next observatory called the plan quite automatic, and everybody laughed.
The automatic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
